statements.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hobo_ci_app_states (digest text PRIMARY KEY, purpose text NOT NULL, account_id text NOT NULL, subject text NOT NULL, expires_ms bigint NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hobo_ci_app_credentials (app_id bigint PRIMARY KEY, ciphertext bytea NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hobo_ci_app_installations (installation_id bigint PRIMARY KEY, app_id bigint NOT NULL, account_id text NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hobo_ci_oauth_states (digest text PRIMARY KEY, browser_digest text NOT NULL, account_id text NOT NULL, secret bytea NOT NULL, expires_ms bigint NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hobo_ci_oauth_sessions (digest text PRIMARY KEY, account_id text NOT NULL, github_id bigint NOT NULL, secret bytea NOT NULL, expires_ms bigint NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS hobo_ci_oauth_states_expires_idx ON hobo_ci_oauth_states(expires_ms)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS hobo_ci_oauth_sessions_expires_idx ON hobo_ci_oauth_sessions(expires_ms)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hobo_ci_platform_app (singleton boolean PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT true CHECK (singleton), status text NOT NULL, session_digest text NOT NULL, token_digest text NOT NULL, state_digest text NOT NULL, expires_ms bigint NOT NULL, app_id bigint)
ALTER TABLE hobo_ci_platform_app ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS owner_metadata jsonb
ALTER TABLE hobo_ci_platform_app ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS owner_session_started_ms bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hobo_ci_platform_app_attempts (session_digest text PRIMARY KEY, status text NOT NULL, created_ms bigint NOT NULL, expires_ms bigint NOT NULL, app_id bigint)
ALTER TABLE hobo_ci_platform_app_attempts ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS created_ms bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
ALTER TABLE hobo_ci_platform_app_attempts ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS app_id bigint
ALTER TABLE hobo_ci_platform_app_attempts ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS metadata jsonb
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS hobo_ci_platform_app_attempts_expiry ON hobo_ci_platform_app_attempts(expires_ms)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hobo_ci_platform_app_invitations (invitation_digest text PRIMARY KEY, session_digest text UNIQUE NOT NULL, expires_ms bigint NOT NULL)
ALTER TABLE hobo_ci_platform_app_invitations ALTER COLUMN session_digest DROP NOT NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hobo_ci_queued_scans ( app_id text NOT NULL, scan_key text NOT NULL, cursor jsonb NOT NULL, due_ms bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, touched_ms bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY(app_id,scan_key))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hobo_ci_queued_api_budget ( app_id text NOT NULL, used_ms bigint NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS hobo_ci_queued_api_budget_time ON hobo_ci_queued_api_budget(app_id,used_ms)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hobo_ci_webhook_repairs ( app_id text NOT NULL, guid text NOT NULL, attempted_ms bigint NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (app_id, guid) )
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hobo_ci_webhook_scan_cursors ( app_id text PRIMARY KEY, cursor_url text )
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hobo_ci_webhook_successes ( app_id text NOT NULL, guid text NOT NULL, seen_ms bigint NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (app_id, guid) )
